description: This file defines interfaces related to warning reporting in the WPEFramework project, including warning events and reporting control mechanisms.

classes.name: IWarningEvent
classes.description: Interface for warning event objects, providing methods for serialization, deserialization, and categorization.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Interface for warning reporting units, allowing warning events to be reported and categories to be managed.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit::IWarningReportingControl
classes.description: Interface for control over specific warning categories, allowing enabling, configuration, and cleanup.

methods.name: ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Method to report a warning event with associated metadata.

methods.name: IsDefaultCategory
methods.description: Checks if a category is a default category, and retrieves its enabled state and configuration.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Announces a warning reporting category for monitoring.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Revokes a previously announced warning reporting category.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Destructor method for IWarningReportingControl to clean up resources.

methods.name: Category
methods.description: Method returning the category name associated with the warning control.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Method to get or set whether the warning category is enabled.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Method to configure the warning category with specific settings.
